thread_title: S. alata var. atrorubra 'elegant' Stone Co, MS
breadcrumb: S. alata var. atrorubra 'elegant' Stone Co, MS

posts.body_html:
Here's another red variant that could possibly be a dark purple-black clone (nigropurpurea), but as stated in another thread, until this thing turns dark, I'm calling it an atrorubra!

Probably missed the peak performance of this clone by a few months, but better late than never! Check out how amazingly red and shapely this clone is! Pics taken 2/2/23:


This is after getting punched in the face with intense wind, hail, and rain, multiple times:
